modules.module_title: Plan and prepare a program for Persons with Disability (PwD)

pcs.pc_description: apply currently accepted practices for planning and designing of specific programs to meet individual needs.
identify specific needs by conducting assessments and reading existing records.
establish planned outcomes including key milestones and targets.
plan functional strategies to meet developmental needs via research etc.
identify relevant support requirements for PwD.
plan adaptation training methodologies and activities in consultation with the Person with Disability or their parents/ guardians as and when required.
arrange required resources as per the specific needs of the learners with disability prior to program commencement.
enlist specialist communication support where it is required. (e.g. ISL Interpreter, braille experts & scribe support etc.).
establish rapport with PwD and/ or their parents/ guardians as and when required.
conduct activities to develop peer relationships and enhance emotional well- being of PwD.
ensure efficient classroom management.
update own instructional practices with changing trends on assistive aids and barrier-free technologies, and other developments in the field.
conduct appropriate activities within a program as per the needs of PwD to increase participation and training outcomes.
monitor the participation and progress of PwD trainees.
assist with the use of aids, including modification, as required.
follow organisational procedures for the collection of equipment and check for damage and/or wear post session.

modules.module_title: Evaluate the effectiveness of the session

pcs.pc_description: evaluate the effect of program on self- esteem and confidence of PwD trainees.
provide and seek feedback on session technique, participation and correct usage of equipment from PwD and their parents/ guardians as and when required and make adjustments accordingly.
identify remedial measures if outcomes are not met.
modify the session based on findings to ensure the individual’s needs continue to be met.

modules.module_title: Maintain health and safety practices in a training/assessment environment

pcs.pc_description: comply with the current health and safety policies of the organization and ensure all the learners follow the same.
identify safety hazards in the training environment.
provide information to all the learners about the safety and health measures (e.g. protocols for reporting sexual abuse) available in the center.
encourage and assist the learners to use first aid as per the center’s procedures.
deal with the emergencies as per the set standards.
ensure the installation of audio alarms for the Persons with Visual Impairment, signages, and pasted instructions on the wall in vernacular for Persons with Hearing Impairment.
report all the incidents, hazards as per the set standards to the designated person.
ensure tidy and sanitized classrooms, labs, equipment, restrooms, and work area are maintained as per guidelines.
ensure the availability of hand wash, alcohol- based sanitizer as per guidelines.
maintain personal hygiene as per guidelines.
ensure learners and colleagues wash/sanitize their hands before and after the session as per guidelines.
ensure appropriate use and disposal of personal protective equipment by self and trainees as per guidelines.
